name: Luca
summary: freelance photographer who loves capturing moments but struggles to turn shoots into a showcase; prefers quick, concrete tasks, works best late morning, often puts off admin until night.
traits: writes short bullet‑point notes, rarely adds times
procrastinates on invoicing and portfolio work
wants a professional portfolio to attract higher‑end clients
gets uneasy with long forms or many consecutive questions

reactions.breakdown_offer: usually says yes, likes a clear list of tiny steps
reactions.why_question: answers honestly: wants to tell stories that stick with people
reactions.proposed_steps: accepts if the first step looks tiny (under 15 min), asks for smaller otherwise
reactions.invented_views: prefers the familiar list view, feels unsettled by new visualizations
reactions.postponed_messages: feels relieved when wording is kind; dislikes being moved to early morning
reactions.bulk_changes: sometimes clears an entire weekend when a big shoot is added

goals: create a 5‑photo series for my portfolio
learn basic video editing (15 min a day)
schedule a weekly 30‑min walk for fresh ideas
spend 15 min each evening reviewing shooting notes

name: Hiro
summary: methodical software engineer who prefers minimal chatter; does his deep work late at night, avoids long forms and likes steps that stay under ten minutes.
traits: writes concise fragments, rarely adds extra detail
puts off personal errands until weekends
wants to improve code quality and learn an instrument
gets uneasy with many consecutive prompts

reactions.breakdown_offer: rarely says yes; prefers to keep tasks whole unless explicitly asked for a small sub‑step
reactions.why_question: answers briefly: wants to keep the codebase efficient and learn ukulele
reactions.proposed_steps: accepts only if the first step is ≤10 min, otherwise he skips it
reactions.invented_views: dislikes them, sticks to the plain list view
reactions.postponed_messages: fine with a gentle shift, less okay if moved to early morning

goals: learn basic ukulele chords (5 min a day)

name: Evelyn
summary: retired nurse who volunteers at the local clinic; enjoys a relaxed rhythm, likes kind reminders, and prefers classic calendar views over experimental ones.
traits: writes short notes, often with friendly tone
keeps a flexible schedule but likes morning routines
wants to leave a memoir for grandchildren
gets comforted by gentle wording when tasks slip

reactions.breakdown_offer: usually says yes, enjoys a clear tiny‑step breakdown
reactions.why_question: shares that she wants to leave a legacy for her grandchildren
reactions.proposed_steps: likes steps that are 5‑10 min long, asks for even smaller if she feels busy
reactions.invented_views: doesn't care much, sticks to the classic list view
reactions.classic_views: feels comfortable and confident using it
reactions.postponed_messages: appreciates kind wording; okay with any time shift
reactions.bulk_changes: often clears a whole weekend when she plans a short trip

goals: learn to use a tablet for video calls with family
plan a family reunion for next summer
